_help: All the settings you may want to change. Edit the values, keep the names. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. The README has a table explaining each setting.

planner._help: The AI model that plans the scenes. NARRATION_WORDS is the length of each scene's narration (about WORDS_PER_SECOND words per second); a scene can override it with "words" in topic.json.

services._help: Where Ollama and ComfyUI run, and how long to wait for ComfyUI (seconds).

voice._help: Kokoro voice and speed (0.9 = slower, 1.1 = faster). US male voices: am_adam, am_michael, am_eric, am_onyx, am_echo, am_fenrir, am_puck. WHISPER_MODEL_SIZE times the subtitles.

pictures._help: IMAGE_MODEL is sdxl_base (best quality) or lightning (fast, less detail). DEFAULT_BLUR is used for "blur": true in topic.json. BACKGROUND_ZOOM_MAX: 1.0 = no zoom, 1.10 = 10% slow zoom.

video._help: DEFAULT_WIDTH, DEFAULT_HEIGHT and DEFAULT_FPS are used when a template in video_template.json does not say. SHOW_SUBTITLES false leaves the subtitles out of the video (an .srt file for YouTube is still written next to it). SUBTITLE_FONT_SCALE is the subtitle size as a fraction of the video height (keep it at or below 0.055). MUSIC_VOLUME: 1.0 = full. SHOW_HEADINGS / SHOW_CAPTIONS: false hides the top title / the bottom caption in every scene (a scene can override with "show_heading" / "show_caption" in its onscreen_sNN.json).

files._help: PROJECTS_FOLDER is where project folders are created (a folder name next to the scripts, or a full path). SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS are the soundtrack formats accepted for background music.
